stories.title: Skubal Meetings Begin — Six Teams, West Coast Preference, Record Deal Looming

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Tarik Skubal begins meetings with six teams — including the Mets, Dodgers, and Padres.

Jim Bowden: He "prefers the West Coast."
Kiley McDaniel projects: 8 years, $352M ($44M AAV).

That would shatter Yamamoto's $27M AAV record for a pitcher.

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Skubal meetings are happening as the CBA expires December 1.

Cubs: "badly" pursuing him (Passan).
Yankees: "thinking about" a push.

The West Coast gets first shot. The clock is ticking for everyone. #MLB

stories.title: Rangers Exploring Corey Seager Trade — $157.5M Deal, Full NTC Complicates

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Texas Rangers are exploring a Corey Seager trade at the GM Meetings in Las Vegas.

Seager: $157.5M over 5 years remaining. Full no-trade clause. .227/.736 OPS in 2026 — career lows.

Texas wants 2027 payroll near $193M. #Rangers

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Teams linked to Corey Seager if he moves:

— Yankees (Sherman pushed back on fit)
— Blue Jays
— Red Sox
— Dodgers
— Braves

The complication: he has full no-trade protection. It's his call. #MLB

The list: Suzuki, Arozarena, Bednar, Bauers, Rogers, Jeffers, Lowe, Morejon.

All 8 expected to decline. #MLB
